draft.subject: Pincode-level RTO models
draft.body:
Hi Meera,

Your post on 18 September said pincode-level models beat Kestrel's city-level RTO model. We saw the same pattern at Tidemark Logistics.

I built Tidemark's return-risk model for COD orders, and RTO fell from 18% to 13% over two quarters. That is close to the returns forecasting work in your Senior Data Analyst opening, so I applied on 21 September.

Would a 15 minute call next week be useful? If someone else owns this hire, a name is plenty.

Thanks,

draft.subject: 40 dark stores in Riverton
draft.body:
Hi Kabir,

Parcelgram's August post says the Series A will pay for 40 new dark stores in Riverton by March. At that pace, stock accuracy is usually the first thing to slip.

At Fernleaf Grocers I ran launch operations for 22 dark stores in 9 months and kept shrinkage under 1.5%.

Are you hiring someone to own store launches yet? If not, 15 minutes of your view on what that role should cover would still help me.

Best,

draft.subject: Backend Engineer, Payments: Vikram Rao
draft.body:
Hello Kestrel Pay hiring team,

Your July post-mortem on the UPI timeout spike described a problem I fixed at Tidemark in 2025. Retries were piling up behind one slow partner bank. Per-bank retry budgets fixed it, and duplicate debit complaints fell from about 40 a week to 2.

That is why the Backend Engineer, Payments role in Lakeside stood out. For the last 4 years I've built Go payment services at Tidemark, including the UPI mandate retry service, which handles about 2 million requests a day. The post asks for UPI AutoPay mandates and Go, which is my daily work.

My tailored resume is attached. My notice period is 30 days, and I'd be glad to walk through the retry design in an interview.

Regards,
